scientific_rationale: The frozen discrimination contract states that absence of a hard break is necessary but not sufficient for SAME. Every blind case contains only candidate-independent evidence that no declared break is observed; no positive independent persistent-identity anchor is present. Candidate X/Y/Z dispositions are competing candidate outputs and cannot serve as ground truth. Therefore the available cutoff-safe evidence cannot lawfully establish SAME, DIFFERENT or AMBIGUOUS for any of the 72 cases; NOT_EVALUABLE is the conservative recommendation for all cases.
